description: This file defines the MessagingTrace class, which implements diagnostic and logging functionalities for messaging events within the Orleans runtime. It includes constants for event names, logging actions, and methods to handle various messaging events such as sending, receiving, dropping, and enqueuing messages.

classes.name: MessagingTrace
classes.description: A class that provides diagnostic and logging capabilities for messaging events in Orleans, implementing DiagnosticListener and ILogger interfaces.

methods.name: OnSendMessage
methods.description: Logs the event of sending a message if enabled.

methods.name: OnIncomingMessageAgentReceiveMessage
methods.description: Logs the reception of an incoming message from the agent and triggers related instrumentation.

methods.name: OnDispatcherReceiveMessage
methods.description: Logs the reception of a message by the dispatcher and triggers related instrumentation.

methods.name: OnDropExpiredMessage
methods.description: Logs the dropping of an expired message at a specific phase.

methods.name: OnDropBlockedApplicationMessage
methods.description: Logs the dropping of a message due to application blocking.

methods.name: OnSiloDropSendingMessage
methods.description: Logs when a silo drops a message to another silo, with reason.

methods.name: OnEnqueueInboundMessage
methods.description: Logs the enqueueing of an inbound message.

methods.name: OnDequeueInboundMessage
methods.description: Logs the dequeueing of an inbound message.

methods.name: OnCreateMessage
methods.description: Logs the creation of a message.

methods.name: OnEnqueueMessageOnActivation
methods.description: Logs enqueueing a message on activation and triggers related instrumentation.

methods.name: OnRejectSendMessageToDeadSilo
methods.description: Logs rejection of a message sent to a dead silo.

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a certain log level is enabled.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Logs a message with specified level, event, and state.
